blend.basis: Ratings blend 2026 results with the preseason projection, weighted by each team's games against FBS opponents — 136 of 136 have faced one; 2 programs new to FBS stay unrated until 5 games; updated grades through week 5

projection.basis: 2025 grades and metrics for returning and incoming players on 2026 rosters, with unproven players held at position average, adjusted for transfers
projection.handoff_note: ranks shift as live results enter because the projection is grade-based and the live rating is play-based; each team moves in proportion to how much it has played
